results_due: around May 2027 (half-yearly reporter; H1 was reported on 28 Oct)
reasoning: Management 'guided 35-40% growth' for FY27 'or bettering' it. FY26 revenue was ₹201 Cr (₹71 Cr in H1, ₹130 Cr in H2), so FY27 of ₹271-281 Cr needs H2 of ₹180-190 Cr after H1's ₹91.5 Cr. The MD also said H2 is 'generally double' H1 and agreed an analyst's ₹300 Cr for the year was 'on track', which would mean about ₹208 Cr. We use ₹190 Cr.

Executable order book is ₹307 Cr (2-9 month execution), which covers H2 comfortably; existing plants run at 95% utilisation, so growth depends on the Ambernath plant starting dispatches from end-November.
Operating margin was 20.6% in H1 and 24.6% in H2 FY26. The MD called the current margin a 'floor' and said fixed costs spread over a larger H2, so we use about 22%.
risks: Ambernath plant starts later than end-November (it already slipped a month)
Working capital: negative operating cash flow of ₹55 Cr in H1 and receivables of ₹120 Cr
caveat: Half-yearly estimates are on Screener's standalone rows.
